pool.text: Construction of Naypyidaw started in this year and was completed later.
The city officially replaced Yangon as the administrative capital of Myanmar.
The stake-driving ceremony for the Uppatasanti Pagoda was held in Naypyidaw.
Construction began on the Naypyidaw railway station building project.
More than 12000 troops marched in a massive military parade in Naypyidaw.
Ngalaik Lake Gardens opened in Naypyidaw with water slides and natural resorts.
The National Herbal Park opened featuring medicinal plants from major regions.
The Naypyidaw Zoological Gardens opened with numerous species and animals.
Uppatasanti Pagoda was completed, resembling the Shwedagon Pagoda in Yangon.
The Naypyidaw railway station officially opened for service.
Mobile phone coverage became available within Naypyidaw.
The government began construction of villas near the Myanmar Convention Centre.
The Naypyidaw Safari Park officially opened on a February holiday.
Nay Pyi Taw International Airport opened south-east of the city.
Russian news media announced a planned metro line project in Naypyidaw.
The Ministry of Information began publishing the weekly Naypyidaw Times journal.
Construction work on the city was completed by this year.
Hotels and inns were built to house athletes and spectators for games.
Naypyidaw was featured on the British motoring TV show Top Gear.
The city suffered extensive damage in the Myanmar earthquake.
